intent: Implement and locally validate native CI, reproducible licensed archives, static CLI generation, trusted-main candidates, supplied-binary acceptance, casks, guarded promotion and metadata. Actual native/hosted/public release gates remain intentionally pending.

evidence: parser-reproduction.log: make test-release-promotion in a faithful owned snapshot accepted concatenated failed/passing CLI reports (exit 0 vs expected 1); all API calls were fixtures.
findings.suggested_fix: Require exactly one JSON value of the expected object shape before reading maintainer approval, gate, verification and performance records; preserve current field/hash predicates and test concatenated failed/passing documents.
findings.title: Reject concatenated approval and acceptance JSON records
findings.why_it_matters: Promotion accepts a hash-bound CLI report containing a failed record followed by a passing record because jq -e uses the last result. The same single-document ambiguity exists in approval and receipt predicates. Refusing concatenated documents before field checks keeps acceptance aligned with the strict candidate manifest parser.
findings.validation_reason: Reviewed 72c5eeb with go1.27.1 in an owned faithful snapshot; concatenated failed/passing hash-bound CLI report reached fixture release completion (exit 0, expected refusal); jq -e predicates lack single-document checks. Approval variant was stopped by a conflicting remote-tag fixture after passing approval, so its full-write reproduction must reset remote state.

evidence: checksum-portability-red.log: candidate, promotion and metadata canonical targets exit 2 with sha256sum command not found when PATH removes only sha256sum and retains shasum; this is a Linux portability fixture, not native macOS acceptance.

GitHub macOS 15 toolset common_packages does not declare coreutils: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/actions/runner-images/main/images/macos/toolsets/toolset-15.json ; official Actions runner workflow explicitly installs coreutils before invoking sha256sum on macOS: https://github.com/actions/runner/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml
findings.suggested_fix: Use a portable shared test-only SHA256 helper with sha256sum when present and shasum -a 256 otherwise; cover both paths and rerun the affected canonical policy targets with sha256sum removed from PATH.
findings.title: Release policy tests require an unavailable GNU hash command
findings.why_it_matters: Canonical release policy tests fail before their assertions on a supported shell that provides shasum but lacks GNU sha256sum. The production release tools already support that environment, so their tests add an undeclared platform prerequisite. A shared test-only digest helper makes the fixture hashes portable without changing shipped code.
findings.validation_reason: Reviewed 72c5eeb; canonical candidate/promotion/metadata targets in a snapshot with only sha256sum removed from PATH exit 2 at the quoted hash command while shasum is available. Native macOS execution not claimed; official toolset does not promise GNU coreutils.
